newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's producer price index up 1.9 percent.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's producer price index up 1.9 percent.

text.p: Colombia's producer price index rose 1.9 percent in February compared to 2.3 percent in the same month last year, a statement from the central bank said Friday.
The accumulated rise in the index for the first two months of this year now stands at 3.3 percent, the statement said.

The cost of goods produced and consumed in Colombia increased 1.8 percent in February, compared with a 2.3 percent gain in February 1996, while the price of imported goods rose 2.7 percent against 2.6 percent in the same month last year.

The central bank said the producer price index was pushed up by rises in the cost of domestically produced coffee, milk, bananas, eggs and tomatoes, the prices of which gained between 6 percent and 16 percent.
Among imported goods, gasoline, motor parts, telecommunications components and aluminum products contributed most heavily to the rise in the producer price index.
Colombia is due to publish its monthly consumer oprice index figures Sunday.
